reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a sequential file's control entry has a FILE STATUS clause, every OPEN, CLOSE, READ, WRITE and REWRITE of that file (successful, at end, or failed with a permanent or logic error) stores the two-character I-O status into data-name-1 before any AT END imperative or USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure runs (VII.1.3.5); the witness covers only successful OPEN/WRITE/READ/CLOSE and READ at end.

edition-consulted.switches: passes ctx.Data.DialectLevel (85) to the runtime FileRegister so the connector's Edition is 85; the status store itself is edition-blind
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: at 85 the physical file, not the connector, is locked (decides when status 38 arises, a status VALUE, not whether it is stored)
DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility off at 85 (no 61 status); again the value, not the store

reader.edition-search: grep CobolVersion|EditionContext|DialectBehavior|DialectLevel over SequentialIoEmitter, SortEmitter, KeyedIoEmitter and DialectBehaviors.IsActive|.Edition over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO; EmitStoreFileStatus consults no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the store into data-name-1 is the same code at 85 and 2023 (p1fail.cob prints identically at --std 2023); only which status value some operations produce is edition-gated, which is VII.1.3.5's subject
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf20_01 exercises successful OPEN/WRITE/READ/CLOSE and READ at end; not failed statements (35, 41, 42, 43, 46, 47, 48, 49), REWRITE, OPEN EXTEND/I-O, the store before a USE procedure, a qualified or group status item, or SORT USING/GIVING

probes.printed: declarative sees status first, then main line: OPEN-IN-M 35; READ-M 47; CLOSE-M 42; WRITE-M 48; OPEN-AGAIN 41; READ-OUT 47; REWRITE-OUT 49; OPEN-EXT-A 00; REWRITE-NR 43; WRITE-IO 48; READ-IO 00 A1; REWRITE-IO 00; AT END <10>; READ-AFTER 46; qualified FSV OF FSG updated inside <..>
probes.expected: VII.1.3.5 values 35/47/42/48/41/47/49/43/48/10/46, each stored before the declarative and the AT END imperative

probes.printed: GRP-STATUS 0/0 (group FS1 of two PIC X, preset ZZ, after WRITE)
probes.expected: group alphanumeric status item updated to 00
USING and GIVING files' status items updated by the SORT's implicit OPEN/READ/WRITE/CLOSE
same store mechanism at both editions

reader.notes: EmitStoreFileStatus is called after every sequential OPEN/CLOSE/READ/WRITE/REWRITE arm and the SORT transfer arms, before exception dispatch; a declared but unresolvable item is a loud guard. All failure classes probed store the right value before the USE procedure runs.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the status values the reader did not try and the placements it did not: refute-1985-119/src/r1stat.cob at --std 85 printed OPEN-OPT-IN 05 (OPTIONAL file absent), first READ AT-END-IMP 10 inside the AT END imperative, CLOSE-NOREW 07, CLOSE-LOCK 00 then OPEN-LOCKED 38 seen by the USE procedure before the main line, WRITE-SMALL 44 (record below RECORD VARYING minimum) in the declarative, REWRITE-DIFF 44 (size differs), and EOP-IMP 00 inside the END-OF-PAGE imperative of a LINAGE file with the item preset ZZ. src/r1link.cob: data-name-1 in the LINKAGE SECTION (allowed by SR2, which excludes only File, Report and Communication Sections), plain and qualified in a group: SUB-OPEN-MISSING 35, SUB-OPEN-W [00], and the caller's storage saw both.
